text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't modify any tests.

The fixes in `catalog/`:
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the comment and tests say five. It's now 5.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns the last `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the third title, so I added `Emma` by Austen (1815, 1 copy). The author, year and copy count are my choice, since the tests only check the title.
